scripts.build: bun build src/server.ts src/ops.ts --target bun --outdir dist && rm -rf dist/review && bun build src/review-client.tsx --target browser --outdir dist/review && mv dist/review/review-client.js dist/review/client.js && mv dist/review/review-client.css dist/review/client.css
scripts.verify-build: bun run build && test -f dist/server.js && test -f dist/ops.js && test -f dist/review/client.js && test -f dist/review/client.css
